pages.text: Gold does not appear in the veins I remember. It survives instead as heavy flakes carried and concentrated by rivers.$(br2)To pan, I must stand in water within a river biome, aim at water, and hold the pan in use for four seconds.

A successful attempt produces between five and fifteen Gold Flakes and costs one durability from the pan.$(br2)Standing beside water is not enough: I must be immersed, the biome must count as a river, and my aim must remain upon water.
